tweaks.name: Graphics card: use MSI interrupts
tweaks.why: Message Signaled Interrupts avoid the old shared interrupt lines and can lower driver latency. Most cards from the last several years already use MSI (the health check shows yours); this only changes cards that don't. Applies after a reboot, and a driver reinstall can reset it.
tweaks.breaks: Very old cards without MSI support can fail to start. Undo it with Revert.bat (or from Safe Mode).
